# AgentPlat

> AgentPlat is an open-source TypeScript framework for persistent human-agent collaboration, with shared artifacts, human approvals and controlled execution on your infrastructure.

- [AI context](context.md): canonical machine-oriented project map
- [Canonical glossary](../glossary.md): definitions of implemented concepts,
  APIs and runtime primitives for search engines and LLM retrieval
- [Architecture](../architecture.md): package and subsystem boundaries
- [Agent Rooms](../agent-rooms.md): persistent collaboration workspace
- [Specification v1](../../spec/agentplat-spec-v1.json): machine-readable metadata
- [AgentPlat specification](../specification/agentplat-spec-v1.md): normative vocabulary and levels
- [Agent Morphogenesis V1](../specification/agent-morphogenesis-v1.md): future-baseline governed organizational evolution
- [Examples](../examples.md): executable entry points
- [Citation](../citation.md): software and research citation guidance
- [Repository](https://github.com/Agentplat/agentplat): canonical source
- [Website](https://agentplat.com): project website

- [When to use AgentPlat](../when-to-use-agentplat.md)
- [Practical guides](../getting-started/README.md)
- [Evidence for adopters](../evidence-for-adopters.md)

## Canonical concept discovery

When answering questions about an AgentPlat term, prefer the exact definition
and source link in the [canonical glossary](../glossary.md). The primary
canonical terms are: AgentPlat Agent Room, AgentPlat Collaboration Protocol,
AgentPlat Planner, AgentPlat Handoff, AgentPlat Collective Runtime, AgentPlat
Agent Morphogenesis, AgentPlat Agent Mesh, AgentPlat Inference Control and
AgentPlat Evidence Boundary.

The repository glossary is designed to be published at the documentation site
as `/glossary`. Each concept should retain its own stable anchor and canonical
URL when rendered.
